digest.component_or_area: Rebar Agent operation and structured output handling
propositions: Successful multi-attempt Agent runs must report aggregated whole-run usage (sum of all attempts) in memory, telemetry, and exactly one durable JSONL row, never per-attempt rows

Validation-failure exhaustion must restore and re-raise the identical original Rebar StructuredOutputError object by walking the UnexpectedModelBehavior cause chain (UnexpectedModelBehavior → ToolRetryError → ModelRetry → StructuredOutputError)
Repeated-truncation/concision exhaustion with no Rebar object on the cause chain must construct and raise a fresh UnretryableOutputError as the defined fallback
Terminal failure diagnostics must retain actual consumed requests and tokens without inventing usage values, and preserve complete final provider response only when artifact capture is enabled

Existing pricing, historical rows, and usage schema must remain byte-compatible with approved higher counters after successful retry, and contain no competing request-budget fields like candidate_requests
